notes.title: Team Ladybug's First Original Metroidvania: New Blade Chimera Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear all,

There's only a month left until the release of Blade Chimera, Team Ladybug's very first original Metroidvania, on January 16, 2025!

You might already know Team Ladybug's well acclaimed ability to develop original games from playing DRAINUS. Blade Chimera now has a new demo, so please try it out to see what their original Metroidvania feels like!

Back in June, we made a demo for Steam Next Fest, and in the past half year that demo has been further improved and expanded on to make this new demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/c12eb0a55ee8ce4f28f9fc6b465f698e777e08fe.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Stage 2: Phoenix Gardens is now playable
[*]Added a new ability to Lux, the Demon Sword: When you’re separated from the Demon Sword, power is charged in the blade. When it returns to you, it creates a shockwave that deals damage along its path
[*]Added a new collectable item: Puzzle Pieces
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/83f454527ba0ef8b530cf4cad2d914fb511c9e4a.gif[/img]

Some parts of the demo might even remind you a little of DRAINUS...
We hope you like the new demo.

notes.title: Nominate DRAINUS for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Released back in May without much fanfare, [i]DRAINUS[/i] has caught the gaming community by surprise, receiving many positive reviews along the way.

[i]DRAINUS[/i], Team Ladybug’s first original IP, is a side-scrolling shooter that retains all that is good of the classics while adding brand new elements to make a fresh take of the genre.

From the unique Reflector that allows you to absorb enemy fire to unleash back at them, endless upgradable customizations, gorgeous pixel art, high-energy soundtrack to the captivating stories and characters, [i]DRAINUS[/i] presents overall excellence in one package, which is why we feel that it is an excellent candidate for Steam Awards’ Game of the Year.

We would appreciate all your support in nominating [i]DRAINUS[/i] as Steam’s Game of the Year!

notes.title: DRAINUS Arcade mode's scoring system
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for playing and supporting [i]DRAINUS[/i]. We along with the developers, Team Ladybug, are happy to hear all of your high praise and feedback on [i]DRAINUS[/i].
We have received several questions regarding the Arcade mode so we would like to take this time and answer them!

◆Basic Scoring and Destroying Enemies
When you destroy an enemy, you will receive points according to the rank of that enemy.

◆ Enemies with score values that change depending on the time
The score of bosses, mini bosses, and enemies that need to be destroyed in order for you to progress will vary depending on the time it takes to defeat them.
The score of bosses, mini bosses, and enemies that need to be destroyed in order for you to progress will vary depending on the time it takes to defeat them.
Defeating an enemy during the time limit will grant you the highest score no matter how quick you defeat the enemy. (There is no score above the highest score)
If you exceed the time limit, the score will gradually decrease and zero points will be awarded after exceeding approximately 1 minute and 30 seconds

●Power-up items
50 points will be added for each power-up item obtained.

●Score Multiplier
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421467/c24e79fde58c028d530413a66cd18e78c6256ca4.png[/img]
Score multiplier increases up to 2.0 times if no damage is taken.
The score multiplier calculates all earned scores.

●Reflector Bonus
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421467/ba7ef6743dafceed43db9f305bf98c1472135070.png[/img]
The more energy absorbed by the Guard, the higher the score.

●Combo Bonus
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421467/5c60fbe3c9abdd6cfa930e71765b56068492eaaf.png[/img]
The more enemies you destroy with one reflector usage, the higher the score.

●Bonuses earned at Results screen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421467/d2626cddc0c653c20cd2a59af887ca1864da73c2.png[/img]
①Energy Tanks Acquired
Earn 500 points per Energy Tank.

②Targets Destroyed
The number of targets destroyed does not affect the score.

③Target Destruction Rate
The closer the destruction rate is to 100%, the higher the score.

④Crystals Acquired
The more crystals you acquire, the higher the score.

⑤Guard Energy
Total number of energy absorbed by the guard x1 point.

⑥Hits Taken
Earn +10,000 points if zero hits taken.

⑦Crashes
Earn +5,000 points if no ship crashes occurred.

⑧Max. Score Multiplier
The highest score multiplier during the stage does not affect the score.

⑨Super Bombs
Earn 100 points per Super Bomb usage.

This concludes the explanation of DRAINUS Arcade mode's scoring system! We hope that cleared some things up!

Try to aim for the highest score!
We hope you continue to enjoy[i] DRAINUS[/i]!

notes.title: Team Ladybug's Latest Original Shooting Game, DRAINUS is available now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[i]DRAINUS[/i] is a 2D Side Scrolling Shooting game created by Team Ladybug. Team Ladybug is known for smash hits like Touhou Luna Nights and Record of Lodoss War -Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth.  

DRAINUS' key features include flying in an aircraft that is capable of absorbing any kind of energy and blasting it right back at the enemy. This along with a ""Normal"" and ""Hard"" difficulty makes the game fun for a wide range of players from casual to hardcore. Additionally, there are two game modes that are unlocked after the game is cleared, allowing for a longer playtime experience. 

But wait, there's more! Users can enjoy a 10% off Launch Sale so make sure to grab the game on Day 1 and shoot em up!
